name: Create CF1 Site Ramps
description: Create CF1 Site Ramps Creates ramps (network connections) for a CF1 Site. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps
Creates ramps (network connections) for a CF1 Site.
Required: account_id (path); cf1_site_id (path); body (body)

name: Create CF1 Sites
description: Create CF1 Sites Creates new CF1 Sites for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites
Creates new CF1 Sites for an account. Each site must have a unique name within the account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete CF1 Site
description: Delete CF1 Site Deletes a specific CF1 Site for an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}

name: Delete CF1 Site Ramp
description: Delete CF1 Site Ramp Deletes a specific ramp from a CF1 Site. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps/{ramp_id}

name: Get CF1 Site
description: Get CF1 Site Gets a specific CF1 Site for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}

name: Get CF1 Site Ramp
description: Get CF1 Site Ramp Gets a specific ramp for a CF1 Site. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps/{ramp_id}

name: List CF1 Site Ramps
description: List CF1 Site Ramps Lists ramps (network connections) associated with a CF1 Site. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}/ramps
Lists ramps (network connections) associated with a CF1 Site. Ramps represent GRE tunnels, IPsec tunnels, interconnects, or MCONN links.
Required: account_id (path); cf1_site_id (path)

name: List CF1 Sites
description: List CF1 Sites Lists CF1 Sites associated with an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites
Lists CF1 Sites associated with an account. A CF1 Site represents a physical customer network location with optional geographic coordinates.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update CF1 Site
description: Update CF1 Site Partially updates a specific CF1 Site for an account. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/cf1_sites/{cf1_site_id}
